overviewTitle: From landing to shipping, in seven streams
overviewLede: The two weeks followed a deliberate progression: get oriented, make the codebase safe to change, then ship on top.

arcs.title: Make it Safe
arcs.story: Added the safety net the frontend was missing: a linter, tests, and CI checks
arcs.why: The frontend had no linter, no tests, and no CI, so any change could quietly break something.
what: Set up ESLint with the React rules of hooks as hard errors
Added a 49-test suite and wired both into CI
impact: Every change now passes automated checks before it can merge
The linter caught a real bug on day one
prs: Stabilize layer: ESLint + Vitest + CI gates

arcs.title: Build a New Tool
arcs.story: Built a new app so anyone can read our specs from a link
arcs.why: Non-technical people needed to read specs that only opened in a code editor.
what: Built a standalone web app that browses all docs and user stories
impact: The specs are now just a link you can send anyone

closing.title: By the numbers, and the pattern underneath

stats.l: unit tests where there were none

takeaways: Safety before speed. Tests and CI landed before the big refactors.
Fixes at the root, not the symptom.
